summary: Delayed supplier settlement: PO-line allocation missing and bank remittance reference mismatch for Seabright Medical Supplies
description:
Issue summary:
Seabright Medical Supplies invoice INV-2026-1189 failed automated PO-match and was held in AP suspense, preventing the scheduled payment run (PAY-20260301-12). The invoice contained SKU-level line detail without the expected PO line references and used a bank remittance string in the 'Payment Reference' field that does not match the format our treasury system expects.

Impact:
- One vendor payment (~$48,320.50) delayed by two business days.
- Potential vendor relationship risk; vendor has opened a collections ticket.
- Manual work required by Finance/Treasury to clear suspense and re-run payment.

Environment:
- AP system: RedwoodAP v3.7.1 (prod)
- Payment processor: ClearSettle (production)
- Affected vendor: Seabright Medical Supplies (vendor_id: VND-1189)
- PO: PO-78823
- Invoice: INV-2026-1189
- Payment run: PAY-20260301-12

Steps to reproduce / reproduction notes:
1) Upload invoice CSV containing SKU-level rows without PO line identifiers into RedwoodAP import.
2) Trigger auto-match routine (ap-match-service) for run PAY-20260301-12.
3) ap-match-service returns 'no-match' because the invoice rows total matches PO total but line-level allocations are blank; matching rules require either explicit PO reference on each line or a single PO header reference.
4) Payment pipeline stops at 'validate-remittance' due to mismatched reference format 'REF:SB-2026' vs expected regex '^PO-\\d{4,}-' or vendor-specific mapping.

Relevant logs and artifacts:
- AP import log: s3://redwood-ap-logs/imports/2026/03/01/INV-2026-1189-import.log
- Match service trace: s3://redwood-ap-logs/match-traces/2026/03/01/match-INV-2026-1189.trace
- Payment run log: s3://redwood-payments/logs/2026/03/01/PAY-20260301-12.log
- Treasury alert: #treasury Slack thread (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C03TREASURY/p1677623456000)

Investigation notes:
- AP engineer (Ethan R.) reproduced local import and confirmed ap-match-service returned MATCH_HEADER_MISSING for PO-allocations.
- Treasury confirmed ClearSettle rejected remittance due to non-standard reference token (their parser strips punctuation and expected a trailing numeric suffix). ClearSettle created a 'reference-mismatch' code in the payment log.
- Finance found that Seabright updated their invoice template on 2026-02-20 and omitted the 'PO:' prefix on every line, instead including a free-text 'PO Reference' only in the header. Our matching rules prefer PO per line for SKU-level invoices.

Root cause:
1) Vendor invoice template change removed per-line PO markers, causing ap-match-service to fail safe and place invoice into suspense.
2) Vendor remittance string contains punctuation and an internal token (REF:SB-2026) that ClearSettle's remittance parser fails to normalize to the vendor mapping we use (SB2026).

Temporary workaround / resolution summary:
- Finance manually applied a PO-level allocation to invoice INV-2026-1189 (AP ticket internal edit) and normalized the payment reference to 'SB2026' in the ClearSettle payment submission.
- Treasury re-ran payment run PAY-20260301-12 for the single record; ClearSettle accepted and funds settled on 2026-03-02.
- Ticket moved to Resolved after confirmation of vendor receipt and reconciliation.

Follow-up items (see follow_up_actions):
- Update vendor onboarding checklist to require per-line PO reference for SKU invoices when PO-driven fulfillment is used.
- Implement normalization rule in payment pipeline to strip punctuation from remittance strings and apply vendor-specific mapping (PR created: github.com/redwood-finance/ap-fixes/pull/402).
- Create monitoring alert for >1% PO-match-failure rate in daily AP runs.
- Outreach to Seabright AP contact to confirm template change and request consistent per-line PO tags going forward.

resolution: Manual PO allocation applied and payment reference normalized; payment re-run and funds confirmed. Vendor committed to revert to per-line PO tags. Automated normalization and monitoring ticketed for engineering.
